ap_definitions.uas_2xx_retransmitted: RAW successful retransmission-to-transport action at action_tick; callback request and logical deadline remain separate events.

overrides.correlation_key: session_id + top Via branch + CSeq number/method + transaction role; ACK additionally uses RFC matching; timer_generation separates every re-arm/reset
overrides.projection_rule: correlate first; exactly one obligation generation per finite word; dynamic identifiers remain event fields; supersession closes the old word before a new monitor is spawned
overrides.monitor_instantiation: EXACTLY_ONE_TRIGGER_PER_PROJECTED_WORD; key=transaction_id+timer_kind+timer_generation; append a terminal position after the largest bounded deadline
overrides.instrumentation_timing: iACK handler 完成 ACK 匹配和 TRANSAC_TIMER_CANCEL(X) 后发 matched_2xx_ack_post_timer_x_cancel；Timer-X callback 真正发送 2xx 时发 uas_2xx_retransmitted；同 tick 严格按 callback/send 与 ACK/cancel 的实际先后拆分 microstep。
overrides.timer_observation_semantics: arm_tick, configured_delay_ms, deadline_tick, callback_tick, action_tick and termination_tick are distinct fields.

overrides.independent_audit_note: Original disposition=FIX retained; repaired formula/AP/traces/primary and auxiliary source mapping. This is not human approval.

overrides.limitations: Finite G* requires projection through Timer L/dialog close.
overrides.same_timestamp_microstep_order: If callback/send precedes ACK at the same integer tick, emit it before the post-cancel trigger; never merge the two positions.

overrides.title: Timer L retains Accepted server transaction for 64*T1
overrides.natural_language: 服务事务发送 2xx 并成功以 64*T1=32000 ms 启动 Timer L 后，32000 ms 前不得进入 Terminated 且应在边界终止；RFC 6026 服务侧性质不允许把传输错误当作提前丢弃例外，Doubango 的 Any transport error 路径因此是已知违反。
overrides.time_source: 固定 RFC 条款及锁定实现 profile；默认整数毫秒值仅在卡片声明的 profile 下使用。
